items.zh: 今晚太累了，不想做饭，点个外卖吧？
items.scene: 合租室友下班回家，看见你瘫在沙发上

answers.en: I'm beat tonight. Want to just order in?
answers.note: order in 指叫外卖到家，I'm beat 很口语；三条里这条最随意，适合熟人室友。

answers.en: Too tired to cook tonight—how about we order delivery?
answers.note: 直接点明不想做饭，order delivery 强调叫外卖；比第一条更明确，像认真商量晚饭。

answers.en: Let's just do takeout tonight, okay?
answers.note: Let's just 带拍板口气，takeout 偏指外带食物；不想再纠结时用，和前两条征求意见不同。

items.zh: 你中午想吃什么？我准备点外卖。
items.scene: 午休前，你探头问旁边工位的同事

answers.en: What are you feeling for lunch? I'm about to order.
answers.note: feeling for 是问想吃什么的口语说法；about to order 表示正要下单，适合熟人同事。

answers.en: Any idea what you want for lunch? I'm ordering delivery.
answers.note: Any idea 比直接问更缓和，ordering delivery 明确叫外卖；适合关系一般的同事。

answers.en: What sounds good for lunch? I'm putting in a delivery order.
answers.note: sounds good 轻松随意，put in a delivery order 指在软件上下单；适合边看手机边说。

items.zh: 你外卖点了吗？要不要一起凑个起送？
items.scene: 加班时，你问还没吃饭的邻座同事

answers.en: Did you order yet? Want to combine ours to hit the minimum?
answers.note: combine ours 指两单合在一起，hit the minimum 是凑起送价；办公室口语，适合熟同事。

answers.en: Have you ordered? We could order together and split the delivery fee.
answers.note: 更完整地说明拼单和分摊配送费，语气商量；适合不熟或想讲清楚时。

answers.en: You order yet? Let's team up so we don't pay the delivery fee.
answers.note: You order yet 省略助动词，team up 很随意；强调不想付配送费，适合关系好的同事。

items.zh: 备注里写“不要香菜”，商家能看见吗？
items.scene: 第一次用新外卖软件，室友盯着手机问你

answers.en: If I put 'no cilantro' in the notes, will the restaurant actually see it?
answers.note: actually 带怀疑，强调商家是否真的会看；适合第一次用软件、心里没底时问室友。

answers.en: Does the restaurant see the special instructions? I want to say no cilantro.
answers.note: special instructions 是外卖软件备注栏的常见说法，语气中性；比第一条更少怀疑，像确认功能。

answers.en: Will they even look at the notes if I ask for no cilantro?
answers.note: even 加强怀疑，look at the notes 指商家会不会看；比前两条更口语，也更不客气。

items.zh: 备注里能不能让骑手别按门铃？
items.scene: 宝宝刚睡着，你边下单边问伴侣

answers.en: Can I ask the driver not to ring the doorbell in the notes?
answers.note: 直接问备注里能不能提这个要求，in the notes 点明位置；适合边下单边跟家人确认。

answers.en: Is there a way to tell the driver not to ring the doorbell?
answers.note: Is there a way 更委婉，像在找软件设置；不带催促，适合不确定备注有没有用时。

answers.en: Would it be okay to put that in the notes?
answers.note: put that in the notes 指把要求写进备注，语气带商量；适合怕写得唐突时。

items.zh: 都一个小时了，外卖怎么还没到？
items.scene: 晚上十点，室友饿着肚子盯着手机

answers.en: It's been an hour—where's our food?
answers.note: 直接表达又饿又急，where's our food 很口语；适合跟室友抱怨，不带客气。

answers.en: Our order's been an hour. Any idea where it is?
answers.note: 语气稍收，Any idea 把问题抛给对方；仍带不满，适合不想显得太冲时。

answers.en: Has it really been an hour? Where's the delivery?
answers.note: 用反问强调等太久，delivery 指那单外卖；抱怨感最明显，适合两人一起等时。

items.zh: 骑手说堵在路上了，让我再等二十分钟，我要不要取消？
items.scene: 午休快结束，你拿着手机问旁边同事

answers.en: The driver's stuck in traffic and says it'll be twenty more minutes. Should I just cancel?
answers.note: just cancel 带干脆放弃的口气；午休快结束、不想再等时最顺口，像找同事拿主意。

answers.en: The driver's stuck in traffic and wants another twenty minutes—should I cancel the order?
answers.note: 转述更完整，语气中性；适合认真征求意见，不是单纯抱怨。

answers.en: Should I wait twenty minutes or cancel? The driver's stuck in traffic.
answers.note: 把等和取消两个选择摆出来，犹豫感强；适合自己拿不定主意时问同事。

items.zh: 外卖显示已送达，门口却没有，能帮我看看是不是送错楼了吗？
items.scene: 你给小区物业打电话，说明情况

answers.en: It says delivered, but there's nothing at my door. Could you check if it went to the wrong building?
answers.note: Could you check 礼貌地请物业查，先摆事实再提请求；适合电话里说明情况。

answers.en: The app says it's been delivered, but there's nothing outside—did the driver get the building wrong?
answers.note: 口语化反问，直接怀疑骑手送错楼；比第一条更急，也更像抱怨。

answers.en: It's marked as delivered, but nothing's here. Can you see whether it was left at the wrong building?
answers.note: marked as delivered 像系统说法，can you see whether 更委婉；适合请物业查监控。

items.zh: 外卖放门口就行，还需要拍照吗？
items.scene: 你不在家，电话里跟骑手交代

answers.en: Just leave it at the door, please. Do you need to take a picture?
answers.note: 先交代放门口，再问骑手要不要拍照；语气直接但带 please，电话里最常用。

answers.en: You can leave it by the door. Is a photo required?
answers.note: 更简洁，Is a photo required 偏流程化；适合赶时间、只想确认一句。

answers.en: Leave it at the door—do you have to take a photo for the app?
answers.note: for the app 点明平台拍照流程，语气随口；适合知道骑手要上传照片时确认。

items.zh: 骑手把外卖挂在门把手上，汤洒了一半，这该怎么处理？
items.scene: 你拎着漏汤的袋子，拍照发给同事

answers.en: The driver hung it on my door handle and half the soup spilled. What do I do about this?
answers.note: 先描述经过再问怎么办，语气又气又无奈；适合发给熟人同事，边拍照边抱怨。

answers.en: Half the soup leaked because it was hanging on my door handle—how should I handle this?
answers.note: 把原因放前面，how should I handle this 稍冷静；适合认真问处理流程，不是单纯吐槽。

answers.en: The soup spilled all over the bag. Should I report it on the app?
answers.note: 直接问要不要在软件上报，给出具体处理方向；语气实际，适合赶时间解决。

items.zh: 咱们是堂食还是打包带走？
items.scene: 中午和同事站在餐厅门口看菜单

answers.en: Are we eating here or getting it to go?
answers.note: eating here 对应堂食，to go 是美式外带说法；最随口，适合同事间快速决定。

answers.en: Do you want to dine in or take it to go?
answers.note: dine in 是餐厅的正式说法，语气中性；适合服务员问或不太熟的同事。

answers.en: Should we grab a table or just take it with us?
answers.note: grab a table 很口语，画面是找座位坐下；适合朋友或熟同事，带商量的口气。

items.zh: 这家店要扫码点餐，你能帮我看看怎么加一份米饭吗？
items.scene: 父母第一次扫码点餐，把手机递给你

answers.en: This place only takes orders through a QR code—can you help me add a side of rice?
answers.note: 说明只能用二维码点单，再请对方帮忙；语气像长辈求助，适合把手机递过去时。

answers.en: I can't figure out this QR menu. Could you add some rice for me?
answers.note: can't figure out 承认不会用，could you 客气；比第一条更短，适合直接让子女代操作。

answers.en: How do I add rice on this thing? I can't work this app.
answers.note: this thing 指点餐页面，work 作动词很口语；带一点着急，适合边戳屏幕边问。

items.zh: 微辣到底有多辣？我平时只能吃一点点辣。
items.scene: 第一次进这家川菜馆，你翻菜单问服务员

answers.en: How spicy is mild here? I can only handle a little heat.
answers.note: handle a little heat 很口语，直接说明承受力；问服务员时清楚又不夸张。

answers.en: What does mild mean at this restaurant? I have a low spice tolerance.
answers.note: low spice tolerance 稍正式，意思最清楚；适合认真确认辣度，不想被辣到。

answers.en: Is your mild actually mild? I can't take much spice.
answers.note: 反问带怀疑，can't take much spice 很随意；适合朋友聚餐或轻松小店，语气更直接。

items.zh: 能不能少放点辣椒，但别完全不放，我想留点味道。
items.scene: 你在小馆子点菜，特意跟老板交代

answers.en: Could you go easy on the chili but not leave it out? I still want some flavor.
answers.note: go easy on 是少放常用说法，but not leave it out 补充要求；语气客气，适合跟老板交代。

answers.en: A little chili, but not too much—I want to keep some kick.
answers.note: 像点单口诀，keep some kick 指保留辣劲；熟客口气，适合小店快速交代。

answers.en: Can you dial back the chili a bit? I don't want it completely plain.
answers.note: dial back 很口语，completely plain 指完全没味道；比前两条更强调别不放。

items.zh: 这菜太辣了，能给我来碗米饭压一压吗？
items.scene: 你被辣得直喝水，招手叫服务员

answers.en: This is way too spicy—could I get a bowl of rice to cool my mouth down?
answers.note: way too spicy 强调受不了，cool my mouth down 指缓解辣感；招手叫服务员时最自然。

answers.en: Could I have some rice? The spice is a bit much for me.
answers.note: a bit much 委婉说太辣，语气客气；适合不想显得挑剔、在正式餐厅时。

answers.en: Can I get a bowl of rice? My mouth is on fire.
answers.note: my mouth is on fire 夸张幽默，画面感强；朋友聚餐时用，轻松不抱怨。

items.zh: 这些没吃完，能帮我打包吗？
items.scene: 家庭聚餐结束，桌上还剩不少菜

answers.en: Could we get the rest of this to go?
answers.note: the rest of this to go 是美式常用说法，直接说剩下的带走；语气自然，适合家庭聚餐。

answers.en: Can you pack up the leftovers for us?
answers.note: pack up the leftovers 更明确，服务员都懂；语气中性礼貌，适合人多的桌子。

answers.en: Would you mind boxing up what's left?
answers.note: boxing up 是餐厅打包的口语说法，would you mind 很客气；适合正式场合或不想麻烦服务员时。

items.zh: 汤也能打包吗？麻烦别洒了。
items.scene: 桌上还剩半盆汤，你叫住服务员

answers.en: Could you pack the soup too? Please make sure it doesn't spill.
answers.note: 先问能否打包汤，再提醒别洒，语气客气清楚；适合服务员正收桌子时。

answers.en: Can the soup go in a container too? I don't want it leaking everywhere.
answers.note: go in a container 很口语，leaking everywhere 强调怕漏；适合熟一点的小店，语气随意。

answers.en: Would it be possible to take the soup home? Just don't let it spill.
answers.note: Would it be possible 很客气，后半句直接叮嘱；适合正式餐厅，也带一点不放心。

items.zh: 服务员，买单，能刷手机吗？
items.scene: 吃完饭你招手叫服务员，掏出手机

answers.en: Excuse me, check please. Can I pay by phone?
answers.note: Check please 是美式叫买单的固定说法，后句问手机支付；最简洁，适合普通餐厅。

answers.en: Could we get the check? Can I scan to pay?
answers.note: 更完整礼貌，scan to pay 指扫桌上的码付款；适合看到二维码、不确定能不能用时。

answers.en: We're ready for the check—do you take WeChat Pay?
answers.note: We're ready for the check 是买单说法；WeChat Pay 指微信支付，适合有收款码时。

items.zh: 我们各付各的，能分开结账吗？
items.scene: 和朋友吃完火锅，大家掏出手机准备分摊

answers.en: Could we split the check? We're paying separately.
answers.note: split the check 常指把总额分开付，先问再说明各付各的；语气自然，适合朋友聚餐。

answers.en: Can we get separate checks?
answers.note: separate checks 是按各自点的菜分开出账单，比 split 更明确；一句话说清，适合赶时间。

answers.en: Is it okay if we each pay for ourselves?
answers.note: each pay for ourselves 更像朋友间说明各付各的，语气随和；不如前两条像餐厅用语。

items.zh: 这顿我来买单，行不行？
items.scene: 老同学聚会结束，你按住朋友的手机

answers.en: This one's on me—okay?
answers.note: This one's on me 是请客常用说法，okay 带商量；适合朋友间推让，语气轻松。

answers.en: Let me get this one. You can pay next time.
answers.note: Let me get this 语气坚定又给对方面子，补一句下次；适合熟人之间争着买单。

answers.en: I've got the check this time, all right?
answers.note: I've got the check 稍正式，all right 收尾像征得同意；适合年长一点的朋友或同事。

items.zh: 周五晚上七点，两个人，还有位置吗？
items.scene: 你打电话给热门餐厅，想订周五的位子

answers.en: Do you have a table for two on Friday at seven?
answers.note: a table for two 是订位最直接的说法，时间和人数清楚；电话里最常用。

answers.en: Are you taking reservations for Friday at seven? Party of two.
answers.note: taking reservations 更正式，party of two 是餐厅行话；适合热门店或高档餐厅。

answers.en: Any chance you have room for two on Friday around seven?
answers.note: Any chance 很口语，around seven 让时间有弹性；适合不确定能否订上时试探。

items.zh: 能订个包间吗？我们大概十个人。
items.scene: 你打电话给餐厅，准备给同事庆生

answers.en: Could we reserve a private room? There'll be about ten of us.
answers.note: about ten of us 说明人数，private room 对应包间；语气礼貌，适合电话订位。

answers.en: Do you have a private room for ten?
answers.note: 最简短直接，先问有没有；适合电话里快速确认，不用多解释。

answers.en: Is it possible to reserve a private room for ten?
answers.note: Is it possible 最客气，适合高档餐厅；比第二条更委婉，像怕给对方添麻烦。

items.zh: 订位要交定金吗？临时去不了能退吗？
items.scene: 你准备订周末的位子，先问清楚规则

answers.en: Do I need to put down a deposit? What happens if I can't make it?
answers.note: put down a deposit 是交定金常用说法，后半句问临时去不了；口语清楚，适合电话确认。

answers.en: If there's a deposit, is it refundable when we cancel?
answers.note: 用 if there's a deposit 把交定金和退款连成一问，refundable 偏正式；适合想一次问清规则。

answers.en: Do you charge a deposit? Can I get it back if something comes up?
answers.note: charge a deposit 问收不收定金，something comes up 指临时有事；语气委婉随意。

items.zh: 菜都凉了，能帮我热一下吗？
items.scene: 你发现刚上的菜不热，叫住服务员

answers.en: This has gone cold—could you heat it up for me?
answers.note: gone cold 很口语，heat it up 是加热常用说法；直接向服务员提要求，语气不重。

answers.en: Could you warm this up? It's not hot anymore.
answers.note: warm this up 语气更轻，not hot anymore 说明情况；礼貌不指责，适合不想闹僵。

answers.en: Sorry, but this dish is cold. Would you mind reheating it?
answers.note: 先 sorry 再说明，would you mind 很客气；适合正式餐厅，或不想让服务员难堪时。

items.zh: 外卖送到的时候汤已经凉了，能申请退款吗？
items.scene: 你打开外卖袋，摸着凉透的汤问室友

answers.en: The soup was already cold when it arrived—can I get a refund?
answers.note: 直接说送到就凉，can I get a refund 问退款；语气实际，适合先确认平台规则。

answers.en: Do you think I can ask for my money back? The soup showed up cold.
answers.note: ask for my money back 更口语，先征求室友意见；带犹豫，不像第一条那么笃定。

answers.en: Is this eligible for a refund? It came cold.
answers.note: eligible for a refund 偏平台条款用语，最简短；适合先问客服或看规则。
